name: Deathwish Bloom
source:
In this hand-drawn romance-mystery visual novel set in a quake post-apocalypse, play as Sky, an impostor scientist racing to recreate a cure only she knows existed. Weave or snap ever-shifting bonds with characters whose harboured obsessions can end your pursuit, just as you can theirs. Unless...

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4117810/Deathwish_Bloom//]Steam[/url]]
translation:
在这部以末日地震为背景的手绘浪漫悬疑视觉小说中，玩家扮演Sky，一名冒名顶替的科学家，竞相重新创造一种只有她知道存在的治疗方法。与角色编织或切断不断变化的联系，这些角色的痴迷可以结束你的追求，就像你可以结束他们的追求一样。除非…

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4117810/Deathwish_Bloom//]Steam[/url]]
